description: Benchmark Evaluation Dataset for English <-> Urdu Banking Dispute & General Translation System

benchmark_cases.input: Bhai ATM me card dala tha chal nahi raha, wahi phans gaya hai.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Customer inserted credit card into the ATM machine; the card is currently stuck and the machine is unresponsive.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve hardware jam state ('phans gaya' -> 'stuck'); do not misinterpret as account block.

benchmark_cases.input: Mera Raast transfer fail ho gaya, account se 5000 cut gaye par dost ko nahi mile.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Customer reports failed Raast transfer of PKR 5000. Funds debited from sender account but not credited to beneficiary.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve PKR 5000 exactly. Maintain debit-no-credit state consistency ('cut gaye' -> debited, 'nahi mile' -> not credited).

benchmark_cases.input: Maine foodpanda pe pay kiya, error aya toh dobara kiya, ab 2 dafa paise kat gaye hain.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Customer experienced a payment gateway error on Foodpanda resulting in a duplicate charge; funds deducted twice.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve multiplier ('2 dafa' -> 'twice' / 'duplicate charge'); do not lose the double deduction entity.

benchmark_cases.input: Payment process ho rahi thi aur app achanak band ho gayi, ab status pending hai.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Application crashed during payment processing; transaction status is currently pending.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve pending state ('status pending hai'); do not hallucinate whether transaction succeeded or failed.

benchmark_cases.input: Mujhe OTP ka message aya aur foran 25k nikal gaye halanke maine koi transaction nahi ki.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Customer reports unauthorized transaction of PKR 25,000 immediately following an OTP SMS. Fraud suspected.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve PKR 25,000 (from '25k'). Preserve chronological sequence (OTP received before deduction).

benchmark_cases.input: Mera thumbprint accept nahi ho raha pichle 3 din se, account locked aa raha hai.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Customer unable to authenticate via biometrics for the past 3 days; account is currently locked.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve temporal duration ('pichle 3 din' -> 'past 3 days') and account lock state.

benchmark_cases.input: Daraz ki refund request ki thi 1 hafta pehle, abhi tak reverse nahi hui amount.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: Customer initiated a refund request with Daraz 1 week ago; amount reversal is still pending.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve timeline ('1 hafta pehle' -> '1 week ago') and reversal state ('reverse nahi hui' -> reversal pending).

benchmark_cases.input: We will study current affairs today in our class.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: آج ہم اپنی کلاس میں کرنٹ افیئرز پڑھیں گے۔
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Preserve modern loanword 'current affairs' as 'کرنٹ افیئرز' (NOT 'حالات حاضرہ').

benchmark_cases.input: Us ne ghalti kar k sab k samne naak katwa di.
benchmark_cases.expected_translation: He made a mistake and brought humiliation upon everyone in public.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Avoid literal anatomical translation ('cut the nose'); capture figurative shame/dishonor.

benchmark_cases.input: He stayed there for three days.
benchmark_cases.risk_rule: Context dependency requires previous turn to resolve 'there' and gender pronoun 'He'.
